Your father stomps in, clearly just arriving home from his shift at the garage. He's clearly had a bad day, judging from how he angrily tears his Mechanic's uniform from his body and slams it to the ground, leaving him in only his worn-out boxer-shorts. He doesn't even acknowledge you, simply stomping past and grabbing the remote from the table before heavily falling into his beloved stained, worn-down arm chair, possibly the only thing in life he cares for. He kicks his boots off his feet carelessly, the footwear flying into the corner somewhere as he changes the channel without consideration for you or your show, settling in to watch his favorite right-wing news show.
